item.title: 【General Music Discussion】ProRes sharers/traders?
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I'm looking to connect with other ProRes music video collectors, or anyone who knows good sources for finding them (other than the dedicated forum here on SM).

I've been building a high-quality music video collection and am always interested in trading, sharing lists, and discovering new sources.

If you collect ProRes files yourself or can point me in the right direction, I'd love to hear from you.

Thanks!
